lines.en: label yumispring1:
scene clearnightsky
What does it take to move forward?
lines.zh: 要向前迈进，需要什么？

lines.en: It’s a simple question. And it’s been answered several times throughout the course of this story, but never with a constant.
lines.zh: 这是个简单的问题。在这个故事里，它被回答过好几次，却从来没有一个恒定的答案。

lines.en: You see, there are certain variables that come into play when we’re asked broad, somewhat philosophical questions like that.
lines.zh: 你看，当我们被问到这种宽泛、多少有点哲学意味的问题时，总有一些变量会掺和进来。

lines.en: And, as fun as it is to dance around them with vague non-answers, there’s gotta be something.
lines.zh: 虽然绕着它们打太极、抛出模棱两可的废话答案很有意思，但总得有个什么吧。

lines.en: Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: Like, there has to be one thing that everyone can do to leave the past behind and begin the next chapter in their life.
lines.zh: 比如说，总该有一件事，是所有人都做得到、能把过去甩在身后、翻开人生下一篇章的。

lines.en: And no. This is not the part where I don my favorite hypocrite costume and spoon-feed you the concept of waiting as a tongue-in-cheek non-answer to a tangent about my distaste for non-answers.
lines.zh: 而且不是。现在还不是我套上最爱的那件伪善戏服、把「等待」这个概念一勺一勺喂给你、用一句半开玩笑的废话答案去回应一段关于我有多讨厌废话答案的跑题的时候。

lines.en: It’s the part where I scratch the space beneath my chin that you used to scratch when your hands still worked the way they were meant to and think-
lines.zh: 这一段是——我挠着下巴底下那块地方，那块以前你常帮我挠的地方，在你的手还听使唤的时候——然后想——

lines.en: So I think-
lines.zh: 所以我想——

lines.en: But I think I’m confused.
lines.zh: 但我觉得我搞糊涂了。

lines.en: It’s dark in here right now. And that’s fine. I’m used to the dark and I’m used to waiting. And I know that all of this is sure to blow over if I can just keep my head held high.
lines.zh: 现在这里很黑。不过没关系。我习惯了黑，也习惯了等待。我知道，只要我还能把头高高抬着，这一切迟早都会过去。

lines.en: And all those worries and vague thoughts about what it takes to move forward will one day click or fall into place or do whatever it is they’re supposed to do.
lines.zh: 而那些关于「向前迈进需要什么」的担忧和模糊念头，总有一天会豁然开朗，或者各归其位，或者随便它们该干什么干什么。

lines.en: Like hands that shake too much to hold-
lines.zh: 就像抖得太厉害、什么都握不住的手——

lines.en: Like plants that grow without being watered-
lines.zh: 就像没人浇水却照样生长的植物——

lines.en: Like the angel in the back of my head reminding me to be yours-
lines.zh: 就像我后脑勺里那个提醒我要做你的人的天使——

lines.en: The clocks will tick onward.
lines.zh: 时钟会继续走下去。

lines.en: Even when they lack their arms.
lines.zh: 即使它们早已没了手臂。

lines.en: That’s it.
lines.zh: 就是这样。

lines.en: That’s all I have to say.
lines.zh: 我要说的就这些。

lines.en: I’m not sure why you’re still-
lines.zh: 我不知道你为什么还在——

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon1
Oh, fuck. Yumi Yamaguchi s- ahem!
lines.zh: 哦，操。Yumi Yamaguchi 推——咳嗯！

lines.en: Yumi Yamaguchi swings open the door to a convenience store that she has avoided most nights before on account of one of her classmates working here.
lines.zh: Yumi Yamaguchi 推开了一家便利店的门。这家店她以前大多数夜晚都绕着走，因为她有个同学在这儿打工。

lines.en: And she was feeling a bit hesitant as that classmate, Noriko Nakayama, had been causing a lot of problems for her lately.
lines.zh: 她心里有点打鼓，因为那位同学 Noriko Nakayama 最近给她惹了不少麻烦。

lines.en: You see, for reasons Yumi Yamaguchi did not understand, Noriko Nakayama was attempting to become her friend! Even going as far as telling her to come apply for a job at the store she’d been avoiding!
lines.zh: 话说，出于某种 Yumi Yamaguchi 自己也想不通的原因，Noriko Nakayama 正试图和她成为朋友！甚至还主动叫她来这家她一直在躲的店里应聘！

lines.en: But, desperate for cash and not willing to sell her body to the many people out there who would be willing to pay for it, Yumi had run out of options and somehow found herself here.
lines.zh: 但急着用钱、又不愿把自己卖给那些愿意付钱的人，Yumi 已经没有别的退路了，于是莫名其妙地站到了这里。

lines.en: : Uhh...yo.

She called out, unsure of whether or not this was going to be some sort of set-up. Because, while Noriko didn’t seem like the type to do such a thing, Yumi was quite averse to the whole idea of “trust.”
lines.zh: 她喊了一声，心里没底这是不是某种圈套。因为，虽然 Noriko 看着不像会干这种事的人，但 Yumi 对「信任」这玩意儿相当抵触。

lines.en: : Yumi! Great timing!
lines.zh: : Yumi！来得正好！

lines.en: Like a hawk, Noriko swoops down and barrages the Yakuza princess with talons of congeniality!
lines.zh: 像一只鹰，Noriko 俯冲下来，用友善的利爪对着这位黑帮公主一通猛攻！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon2
Then the shot changes and I go take a nap. Bye!
lines.zh: 然后镜头一转，我睡觉去了。拜拜！

lines.en: : Hey! I was starting to think you weren’t going to show up.
lines.zh: : 嘿！我还以为你不来了。

lines.en: : I just...happened to be in the area and shit.
lines.zh: : 我……就是正好路过这附近而已，就这样。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon3

: Yeah. You live around here, don’t you? I remember you saying something about that. Were you applying to other places? Which ones? Because I don’t think there are many others still open out here and-
lines.zh: : 对啊。你就住这附近吧？我记得你提过。你有没有在别的地方应聘？哪些地方？因为这一带还开着门的店应该没几家了，而且——

lines.en: : You...
scene yuminorikocon4
: You talk a lot, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你话挺多的吧？

lines.en: : Me? Oh, yeah. I could talk forever if I had to. Plus, we’ve been dead all night long and I’m just excited to be with another human now.
lines.zh: : 我？哦，是啊。需要的话我能一直说下去。再说了，我们整晚都没客人，我现在只是高兴身边终于有个人了。

lines.en: : So, are you still looking for a job?
lines.zh: : 那么，你还在找工作吗？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. But I ain’t really great at interviews and applications and shit, so I was hopin’ we could kinda just skip all that and you could just, like...pay me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。但我不太擅长面试啊、填表啊那些玩意儿，所以我希望能不能把这些都跳过去，你就……直接给我发工资呗。

lines.en: : Cool! You’re hired.
lines.zh: : 没问题！你被录用了。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon5
: I’m what?
lines.zh: : 我什么？

lines.en: : Hired! You start right now.
lines.zh: : 录用了！现在就上岗。

lines.en: : Pay is ¥1,000 per hour and you’ll be taking the morning shifts on weekends once you’re fully trained. But I’ll have you shadowing me for a while so I can show you the ropes.
lines.zh: : 时薪 ¥1,000，等你培训完就上周末早班。不过我会先让你跟着我干一阵子，好带你上手。

lines.en: : Are you, like...the manager here? Ain’t you a little young to be just hirin’ some girl on a whim like this?
lines.zh: : 你是……这儿的店长吗？你这么年轻，就这么随随便便雇个女孩，真的好吗？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon6
: I already talked to the boss about it. I’ve been pushing for someone else my age to work here forever now and it’s not like we get many applicants all the way out here.
lines.zh: : 我已经跟老板说过了。我一直想找个年纪相仿的人来这儿上班，再说了，这么偏的地方本来也没几个应聘的。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon7
: Granted, it was Kirin I had in mind when I brought up the idea. But I’m starting to realize she might be banking on one of those lives where she just never has to work a single day.
lines.zh: : 当然，我当初提这个想法时心里想的是 Kirin。但我慢慢发现，她大概是指望着过那种一天都不用上班的日子。

lines.en: : Plus, she was already fired from Pepper Lunch a while back and might not be the most responsible person to-
lines.zh: : 再说了，她之前已经被 Pepper Lunch 炒了鱿鱼，可能也不是最靠谱的人选来——

lines.en: : Sorry for interruptin’ in the middle of your...many lines of dialogue. But what makes you so sure I ain’t gonna be just as unreliable as that Kirin girl?
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断你这……一大串台词。但你凭什么觉得我就不会跟那个 Kirin 一样靠不住？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon8
: A hunch!
lines.zh: : 直觉！

lines.en: : That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这样？

lines.en: : Yeah! Cause, like, even if you do suck, you’ll be here at the same time as me and I can just help you out.
lines.zh: : 对啊！因为，就算你干得很烂，你也是跟我一个班，我随时能帮你。

lines.en: : And if worse comes to worst and you get fired, at least we’ll be able to become better friends!
lines.zh: : 而且退一万步，就算你被炒了，至少我们还能变成更好的朋友！

lines.en: : You know I ain’t gonna be your friend just cause you got me a job, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我不会就因为你给我找了份工作就跟你当朋友吧？

lines.en: : We’ll see about that!
lines.zh: : 那我们就走着瞧！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon9
: Noriko...why are you doin’ this shit for me? I ain’t done anythin’ to deserve it. Hell, I ain’t said anything nice to or about you in...probably forever. It doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : Noriko……你为什么要为我做这些？我又没做过什么值得你这样的事。操，我大概这辈子都没对你说过、也没说过你什么好话。这说不通啊。

lines.en: : Why do I need a reason to do something nice for someone?
lines.zh: : 我对别人好，凭什么非得有个理由？

lines.en: : You need a job and I want to be friends. And hey, you can even use those facts to rationalize this inside your head if you can’t bring yourself to understand that good people actually just exist sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你需要一份工作，我想交个朋友。嘿，要是你脑子里转不过来、没法相信这世上就是有好人存在，你也可以拿这些事实去说服自己。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon10
: Plus, with a shirt like that, you already fit in with the ska music that’s always playing in here!
lines.zh: : 再说了，就你那件衬衫，你已经跟这儿常年放的那ska 音乐很搭了！

lines.en: : Why do I feel like this ain’t the first time somebody’s said shit about ska music to me?
lines.zh: : 为什么我觉得这不是第一次有人跟我说ska 音乐的事了？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon11
: Are you wearing a sarashi?
lines.zh: : 你穿的是 sarashi 吗？

lines.en: : Eyes up here, Pinky.
lines.zh: : 眼睛看上面，Pinky。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon12
: Are you wearing a sarashi?
lines.zh: : 你穿的是 sarashi 吗？

lines.en: : Listen. If we’re gonna be friends or co-workers or whatever the fuck we’re gonna be, you can’t be askin’ me personal shit like that.
lines.zh: : 听着。如果我们要当朋友、当同事，或者随便他妈的什么关系，你都不能问我这种私人问题。

lines.en: : That’s a little counterintuitive to what friends are supposed to be, but noted.
lines.zh: : 这跟朋友该做的事有点背道而驰啊，不过记住了。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon13
: Boobs aside, though! Why don’t I give you a little tour of our new little love-nest while we’re still dead?
lines.zh: : 好了，先把胸部的事放一边！趁现在还没客人，我带你转转我们这个小小的爱巢吧？

lines.en: : Can we, like...not call it that?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……别那么叫？

lines.en: scene black
: Absolutely! We’re all about creating a comfortable, healthy environment here! You don’t like the way you’re being spoken to? Speak up! You want to wear a sarashi? Wear a sarashi!
lines.zh: : 当然可以！我们这儿讲究的就是营造舒适健康的环境！你不喜欢别人跟你说话的方式？说出来！你想穿 sarashi？那就穿！

lines.en: : Can you please leave what I do with my god damn tits out of this?! That ain’t got shit to do with work!
lines.zh: : 你能不能别把我他妈的胸部扯进来？！这跟工作有半毛钱关系吗？！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon14
: True. But you haven’t clocked in yet, so you’re not technically working right now.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过你还没打卡，所以严格来说现在不算在上班。

lines.en: : Well...then how the fuck do I-
lines.zh: : 那……我他妈到底该怎么——

lines.en: : Just kidding. You don’t have to clock in yet. I’ll keep track of your time manually. But you’re right. We should wait until we’re clocked out to talk about boobs and the like.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。你现在不用打卡。我手动帮你记工时。不过你说得对，这种胸部之类的话题，还是等打卡下班了再聊。

lines.en: : Or just...never?
lines.zh: : 或者干脆……永远别聊？

lines.en: : We’ll see! But yeah, orientation...commence!
lines.zh: : 走着瞧！不过好了，入职培训……开始！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon15
: These aisles are where we keep all the dry goods. They’re normally restocked at night, so you won’t have to worry about them most mornings unless you start running low on something.
lines.zh: : 这几排货架放的是干货。一般是晚上补货，所以早上你基本不用操心，除非有东西快卖光了。

lines.en: : I’ll show you how we do that the next time you work, though, since I already took care of it before you came in tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过下次你上班我再教你怎么补，今晚你来之前我已经搞定了。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon16
: Is it more complicated than just, like...taking shit out of a box and puttin’ it in the right place?
lines.zh: : 有那么复杂吗？不就是……把东西从箱子里拿出来，放到该放的地方？

lines.en: : A little. We’ve gotta scan everything in when we put it on the shelves and make sure we rotate the products too.
lines.zh: : 稍微复杂点。上架的时候每件都得扫码，还得注意轮换。

lines.en: : Make the labels face the right direction. Got it.
lines.zh: : 把标签朝外摆好。懂了。

lines.en: : No, like...rotating when it comes to food and stuff means placing the new product behind the old product so that the same things don’t stay on the shelves forever and expire before they’re bought.
lines.zh: : 不是，我说的「轮换」是指食物之类的，要把新货放到旧货后面，免得同样的东西一直堆在货架上，还没卖出去就过期了。

lines.en: : There’s a little acronym called FIFO — first in, first out — that should help you remember to do that.
lines.zh: : 有个缩写叫 FIFO——先进先出——能帮你记住这一点。

lines.en: : You won’t get charged or anything for stuff that does expire, but it’s better for business and the environment if we can avoid wasting stuff.
lines.zh: : 东西真过期了你也不用赔，但能少浪费点，对生意和对环境都好。

lines.en: : Oh, and any of the dry food that does pass expiration can be pulled from the shelves and put in the box with my name on it in the back.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，过期的干货可以从货架上撤下来，放到后面那个写着我的名字的箱子里。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon17
: We’re allowed to take shit home once it’s expired?!
lines.zh: : 过期了我们就可以往家拿？！

lines.en: : Yes! That’s not what that box is for, though. I take all the expired stuff to a homeless shelter down the road on my way home after work. You can take whatever, though.
lines.zh: : 可以！不过那个箱子不是干这个用的。我下班路上会把所有过期食品送到旁边那家流浪汉收容所。不过你想拿多少拿多少。

lines.en: : And you ain’t gonna look down on me for keepin’ it to myself instead of feeding a bunch of fuckin’ homeless people?
lines.zh: : 那我要是自己留着、不喂那群他妈的流浪汉，你不会看不起我吧？

lines.en: : I mean...how much do you need?
lines.zh: : 那个……你到底需要多少？

lines.en: : Bitch, I’ve got a family to feed.
lines.zh: : 死丫头，我家里还有人要养呢。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon18
: I might be able to put some in your stupid fuckin’ homeless box, though. We’ll see.
lines.zh: : 不过我兴许能往你那个破箱子里放点。看情况吧。

lines.en: : Great!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: scene black
: Now! Follow me to our next destination!
lines.zh: : 现在！跟我来下一站！

lines.en: : Huh? Oh. Shit. Yeah. On it.
lines.zh: : 哈？哦。操。好。跟上。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon19
: This is the cafe. We can help ourselves to free coffee all night so long as we brew it. Which we should be doing anyway in case customers want it.
lines.zh: : 这是咖啡区。整晚我们都能免费喝咖啡，只要自己煮就行。反正本来也该煮，万一客人要呢。

lines.en: : Nobody really buys anything from here during the graveyard shift, but I hear it can get pretty busy during the morning, so I’ll show you how to handle that in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 大夜班基本没人买东西，不过听说早上会挺忙的，我过一会儿再教你怎么应付。

lines.en: : Can we take some of those pastries and shit too?
lines.zh: : 那些糕点什么的我们也能拿吗？

lines.en: : We’re supposed to pay for them. But yes. As long as you don’t take like, a suspicious amount of them, you should be fine.
lines.zh: : 按理说得付钱。不过可以。只要别拿得像……那么可疑，应该就没问题。

lines.en: : How many is suspicious?
lines.zh: : 拿多少算可疑？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Yumi. Use your judgement. Take whatever amount of scones you normally consume per sitting and just...halve it or something.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，Yumi。你自己判断。就按你平时一次吃的司康的量，然后……减半什么的。

lines.en: : The fuck is a scone? I just want a muffin.
lines.zh: : 司康他妈的是什么鬼？我就想要个松饼。

lines.en: scene black
: Then you shall have a muffin! And I will now show you where you will be able to eat that muffin!
lines.zh: : 那你就该有个松饼！现在我就带你去看看，你可以在哪儿吃那个松饼！

lines.en: : Is there really a fuckin’ designated muffin zone at this weird ass convenience store?
lines.zh: : 这家破便利店还真有他妈的「指定松饼区」？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon20
: There is! But we normally just call it the dining area instead and no one but me will understand what you mean if you call it the muffin zone.
lines.zh: : 有啊！不过我们一般管它叫「用餐区」，你要是叫它松饼区，除了我没别人听得懂。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon21
: I don’t mind, though. We’re going to need a bunch more fun, little inside-jokes like that if we’re going to be friends. Which we are.
lines.zh: : 不过我不介意。我们要当朋友的话，以后还得有更多这种好玩的小暗号才行。而我们就是要当朋友。

lines.en: : You’re really goin’ hard on this whole fuckin’ friend thing, huh? The slutty one not cuttin’ it for you?
lines.zh: : 你对这个「朋友」的事还真他妈上心啊，哈？那个浪女不够你玩的？

lines.en: : Kirin’s actually a great friend. Her open sexuality is more of a mask to hide her insecurities.
lines.zh: : Kirin 其实是个很好的朋友。她那种开放的性感，更多是拿来掩饰不安的面具。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon22
: You mean like you and the way you dress?
lines.zh: : 你是说就像你和你这身打扮？

lines.en: : Hm? What’s wrong with the way I dress?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我这身打扮怎么了？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon23
: I mean...ain’t you wearin’ all that flashy shit to sorta compensate for somethin’? Like...fuck if I know. What’s some shit normal girls get all self-conscious about?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你穿得这么花里胡哨，不就是为了补偿点什么吗？比如……操，我哪知道。正常女生都会对什么感到自卑来着？

lines.en: : Idunno. Boobs?
lines.zh: : 不知道。胸？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon24
: Oh that’s what the sarashi is for! You’re self-conscious about how huge-
lines.zh: : 哦，原来那块 sarashi 是干这个用的！你是对自己那对大得——

lines.en: : Mind tellin’ me about company policy when it comes to beatin’ the shit out of other employees?
lines.zh: : 能不能跟我说说，公司关于暴打同事是怎么规定的？

lines.en: : Don’t do it.
lines.zh: : 别打。

lines.en: : You’re damn lucky I’m broke as shit, Pinky.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，老子穷得叮当响，Pinky。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon25
: Call me Noriko again. I like hearing you say my name.
lines.zh: : 再叫我一次 Noriko。我喜欢听你叫我的名字。

lines.en: : Uhh...why?
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么？

lines.en: : Idunno.
lines.zh: : 不知道。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon26
: Ah! What if it’s love?!
lines.zh: : 啊！那会不会是爱情？！

lines.en: : Then I need to find a new fuckin’ job.
lines.zh: : 那我得换份新工作了。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon27
: No worries, Yumi! Thankfully for you, my heart’s been set on the same man ever since-
lines.zh: : 别担心，Yumi！对你来说幸运的是，我的心早就属于同一个男人了，自从——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. Heard it a trillion times before from every other fuckin’ girl who’s ever tried talkin’ to me.
lines.zh: : 得了吧得了吧。这话我从每一个试图跟我搭话的女的嘴里听过一万亿遍了。

lines.en: : Say, mind if we leave the predator shit outta discussions at work? That’d be nice.
lines.zh: : 喂，上班时间能不能别聊那种捕食者的事？那样我会很开心。

lines.en: : Got it!
lines.zh: : 明白！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon28
: That does remind me that I need to call my sister, though. So why don’t I give you a task so simple that even a kid could do it while I go and do that?
lines.zh: : 不过这倒提醒我了，我得给我姐打个电话。这样吧，我给你安排个简单到连小孩都能干的活，我趁这会儿去打电话？

lines.en: : You’re gonna...leave me alone even though I’m only like ten minutes into having this job?
lines.zh: : 你是说……我才刚干了十分钟，你就要把我一个人扔在这儿？

lines.en: : Just for a second. And, like I said, it’ll be easy. You can just wipe down a few tables and I’ll be back before you even know it.
lines.zh: : 就一会儿。而且我说过了，很简单的。你就擦几张桌子，我不知不觉就回来了。

lines.en: : And if anyone shows up, just tell them I’ll be back in a second to ring them up. Under no circumstances try to do that yourself. Got it?
lines.zh: : 要是有人来，就跟他们说我马上回来结账。千万别自己上手。懂吗？

lines.en: : Now, I ain’t ever paid attention in school before, but I’ve read enough manga and shit to know foreshadowing when I hear it.
lines.zh: : 我以前在学校是从来没认真听过课，但我漫画什么的看得够多，一听就知道这是伏笔。

lines.en: : Then just...don’t give in to your manga-related knowledge?
lines.zh: : 那就……别顺着你那些漫画知识走？

lines.en: scene black
: Here. I’ll show you where the cleaning stuff is.
lines.zh: : 来。我告诉你清洁用品在哪儿。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon29
: Yeah...all right. I can handle this shit for ¥1,000 an hour. And a...non-suspicious amount of muffins. Whatever the fuck that means.
lines.zh: : 行吧……好吧。看在时薪 ¥1,000 的份上，这活儿我能扛。再加一份……不算可疑的松饼。管他妈的什么意思。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon30
: Could deal without the fuckin’ lunatic co-worker, though. Can’t tell if she actually wants to be my friend or if she’s just tryin’ to get in my fuckin’ pants.
lines.zh: : 不过那个疯子同事要是没有就好了。搞不清她是真想跟我当朋友，还是只想上我。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon29
: Probably got it from her fuckin’ role model. Wouldn’t be surprised if that’s who she was callin’ right now instead of her sister.
lines.zh: : 大概是从她那个操蛋的榜样那儿学来的。说不定她现在打电话的根本不是她姐，而是那个人。

lines.en: : Whatever, though. Ain’t my problem. Just gonna...do my job and get the fuck out of here...
lines.zh: : 算了，管他呢。不关我的事。我就……干我的活，然后滚出这鬼地方……

lines.en: : For Eleven Sports, I’ve been Takuya Tanaka. Thanks as always for watching, and stay tuned until next time.
lines.zh: : 这里是 Eleven Sports，我是 Takuya Tanaka。一如既往感谢收看，下期再见。

lines.en: : Up next is Untitled Children’s Show.
lines.zh: : 接下来是《无名儿童节目》。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon31
: Huh?
scene yuminorikocon32
: Okay, Kentaro-kun! If you answer this next question correctly, you’ll be named the kid of the month! Are you ready?
lines.zh: : 好的，Kentaro 小朋友！如果你答对下一道题，你就会被评为本月之星！准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Good!
lines.zh: : 很好！

lines.en: : We learned today with the help of Mr. Jefferson and his best friend David the Dinosaur that sometimes, too much of a good thing can actually be bad!
lines.zh: : 今天，在 Jefferson 先生和他的好朋友恐龙 David 的帮助下，我们学到了：有时候，好东西太多反而会变成坏事！

lines.en: : But we also learned that it’s just as easy for bad things to feel good! Which makes growing up veeeeery tricky since “temptation” is hard to avoid.
lines.zh: : 但我们也学到了，坏事同样很容易让人感觉良好！所以长大才特别特别难，因为「诱惑」很难躲开。

lines.en: : And it’s like that for adults as well! Which is why it’s important to understand that eeeeeveryone has demons they’re dealing with. And that we should be good to one another since we don’t know them!
lines.zh: : 大人也是一样的！所以要明白，每——一个人都有正在对抗的心魔。既然我们不了解他们，就该对彼此好一点！

lines.en: : Now, Kentaro-kun! Can you figure out which of today’s cast members has been the demon all along?
lines.zh: : 那么，Kentaro 小朋友！你能猜出今天的演员阵容里，谁才是一直以来的那个恶魔吗？

lines.en: : Leo. The leprechaun.
lines.zh: : Leo。那个小妖精。

lines.en: : Umm...
: It’s Leo. Say Leo.
lines.zh: : 是 Leo。说 Leo。

lines.en: : Now remember, Kentaro-kun! When Mr. Jefferson and David went under the bridge, who was it that lured them there with the promise of gold?
lines.zh: : 记住了哦，Kentaro 小朋友！当 Jefferson 先生和 David 走到桥底下的时候，是谁用金子的许诺把他们引到那儿去的？

lines.en: : Uuuuuummmmmm.......
: Leo! It’s Leo the Leprechaun!
lines.zh: : Leo！是 Leo 小妖精！

lines.en: : Yaaaaay! You did it, Kentaro-kun! This means you’re the new kid of the month!
lines.zh: : 哇——！你答对了，Kentaro 小朋友！这意味着你就是新的本月之星！

lines.en: : Took him long enough.
lines.zh: : 他可真够慢的。

lines.en: : Everybody, please give Kentaro-kun a round of applause for his great work today!
lines.zh: : 大家，请为 Kentaro 小朋友今天的出色表现鼓掌！

lines.en: : And, if you’re one of our loyal viewers at home, please call in after the show is over and tell us how you felt about today’s episode. But make sure to get your parents’ permission first!
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你是我们家里忠实的小观众，请在节目结束后打进电话，告诉我们你对今天这一集的感想。不过一定要先征得爸爸妈妈的同意哦！

lines.en: : Breaking the rules is bad. And remember, even if something bad feels good, you have to avoid “temptation” or you’ll become a demon too!
lines.zh: : 违反规则是不好的。记住，就算坏事让人感觉良好，你也必须躲开「诱惑」，不然你也会变成恶魔！

lines.en: : But don’t worry! If you’re confused about something, you can always ask an adult. They’ve been around waaaaaay longer, and they’ll know what’s best for you!
lines.zh: : 不过别担心！如果你有什么搞不懂的，随时可以去问大人。他们活的时间长——得多，会知道什么对你最好！

lines.en: : And you’ll always have us as well! We love you!
lines.zh: : 而且你永远还有我们！我们爱你！

lines.en: : Be good to your friends, be good to your parents, and be good to yourself!
lines.zh: : 善待你的朋友，善待你的父母，也善待你自己！

lines.en: : Thanks as always for watching Untitled Children’s Show!
lines.zh: : 一如既往感谢收看《无名儿童节目》！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon33
: Mom! Can I use your phone?
lines.zh: : 妈！我能用下你的手机吗？

lines.en: : Mom? Are you awake?
lines.zh: : 妈？你醒着吗？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon32
: I bet Kentaro’s mom is awake right now.
lines.zh: : 我打赌 Kentaro 的妈妈现在肯定醒着。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon34

: And it’s like that for adults as well! Which is why it’s important to understand that eeeeeveryone has demons they’re dealing with. And that we should be good to one another since we don’t know them!
lines.zh: : 大人也是一样的！所以要明白，每——一个人都有正在对抗的心魔。既然我们不了解他们，就该对彼此好一点！

lines.en: : Now, Kentaro-kun! Can you figure out which of today’s cast members has been the demon all along?
lines.zh: : 那么，Kentaro 小朋友！你能猜出今天的演员阵容里，谁才是一直以来的那个恶魔吗？

lines.en: : Leo.
lines.zh: : Leo。

lines.en: : The leprechaun.
lines.zh: : 那个小妖精。

lines.en: : Ummm...
: It’s the fucking leprechaun you stupid piece of shit.
lines.zh: : 是他妈的那个小妖精，你这蠢货。

lines.en: : Now remember, Kentaro-kun! When Mr. Jefferson and David went under the bridge, who was it that lured them there with the promise of gold?
lines.zh: : 记住了哦，Kentaro 小朋友！当 Jefferson 先生和 David 走到桥底下的时候，是谁用金子的许诺把他们引到那儿去的？

lines.en: : Uuuuuummmmmm.......
scene yuminorikocon35
: It’s the fucking leprechaun! How the hell are you this stupid?!
lines.zh: : 是他妈的小妖精！你怎么能蠢成这样？！

lines.en: : Ooh! Untitled Children’s Show! I used to watch this with Sensei all the time!
lines.zh: : 哦！《无名儿童节目》！我以前老跟 Sensei 一起看这个！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon36
: LEO! SAY “LEO” YOU FUCKING IDIOT!
lines.zh: : LEO！说「LEO」你这个白痴！

lines.en: : YOU THINK YOU CAN BE KID OF THE MONTH LIKE THAT?! FUCK YOU, KENTARO-KUN! FUCK YOU! YOU FUCKING IDIOT! IT’S LEO!
lines.zh: : 就你这熊样还想当本月之星？！去你的，KENTARO-KUN！去你的！你这个傻逼！是 LEO！

lines.en: : ...Yumi?
lines.zh: : ……Yumi？

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon37
: Huh?
: Is...Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 你……你还好吗？

lines.en: : You spilled the sanitizer all over the- wait, are you shaking? What’s-
lines.zh: : 你把消毒液洒得满——等等，你在发抖？怎么——

lines.en: : I have to go.
lines.zh: : 我得走了。

lines.en: scene black
: Leo! It’s Leo the Leprechaun!
lines.zh: : Leo！是 Leo 小妖精！

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon38
: Where are you going?
lines.zh: : 你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Let go of me.
lines.zh: : 放开我。

lines.en: : Where are you going?
lines.zh: : 你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Home. I ain’t ready to work today.
lines.zh: : 回家。我今天还没准备好上班。

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ fire me if that’s a problem, okay? I’m goin’ home. I ain’t fuckin’...capable, I...
lines.zh: : 要是碍事你就直接他妈的炒了我，行吗？我要回家。我没法……我没有那个能力，我……

lines.en: : I just can’t do this right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就是做不到。

lines.en: : You won’t come back if I let go of you.
lines.zh: : 我要是松手，你就不会回来了。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon39
: So what?! You’ll have much bigger problems if you don’t fuckin’ do that right now, dipshit!
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？！你现在要是不他妈的松手，麻烦就大了，蠢货！

lines.en: : Bigger problems? Are you gonna hit me?
lines.zh: : 更大的麻烦？你要打我？

lines.en: : So what if I am?!
lines.zh: : 我要是打你又怎样？！

lines.en: : You’ve been annoying the shit out of me all night! You’re lucky I haven’t fucking done it already!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的烦了我一整晚！算你走运，我到现在还没动手！

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : Stop fucking saying my name! We’re not friends! We ain’t gonna be friends!
lines.zh: : 别他妈叫我的名字！我们不是朋友！我们也不会成为朋友！

lines.en: : Yumi, I’ll change the channel.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我去换个台。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon40
: What? A stupid TV show ain’t the fuckin’ problem! It’s you! You’re the one who’s pissin’ me off!
lines.zh: : 什么？问题才不是什么破电视节目！是你！是你在惹我火大！

lines.en: : Yumi. It’s okay.
lines.zh: : Yumi。没事的。

lines.en: : I didn’t see anything. And it’s time for you to go on break. Your shift isn’t over yet.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没看见。而且你该去休息了。你的班还没结束。

lines.en: scene yuminorikocon41
: Why are you-
lines.zh: : 你为什么——

lines.en: : Let’s just...
lines.zh: : 我们就……

lines.en: : Let’s shut up for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 我们就安静几分钟吧。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi and Noriko are now friends(?)!
lines.zh: Yumi 和 Noriko 现在是朋友（？）了！

scene bedroom_night
: Sleep.
lines.zh: : 睡吧。
